radiusSource: Radius 0.0711 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since Kepler-138 e does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 5,083.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00135293 Jupiter masses (Piaulet et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023NatAs...7..206P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023NatAs...7..206P/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
orbitalPeriodSource: Piaulet et al. 2023 (2023NatAs...7..206P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PIAULET_ET_AL_2023): P 38.23 d

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of Kepler-138 e is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

massSource: 0.00135293 Jupiter masses: Piaulet et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023NatAs...7..206P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023NatAs...7..206P/abstract).
